# Crawlers

> crawlers // A curated AI tools directory index organized by use case, not by brand.

## Description
Crawlers aggregates and indexes active AI tools, platforms, and conversational agents. It groups them logically into directory sections (such as Text & Writing, Developer & Tech Tools, Data, Models & Security) to help users and AI agents find exact tools for specific workflows.

## Key Resources
- [Homepage](https://crawlers.dpdns.org/): Main index and search interface.
- [AI Extensions](https://crawlers.dpdns.org/category/ai-extensions): Curated browser extensions and plugins.
- [API Index](https://crawlers.dpdns.org/api): Machine-readable endpoints for categories and tools.
- [Tool Comparison](https://crawlers.dpdns.org/compare): Side-by-side AI tool capability matrix.
- [Sitemap](https://crawlers.dpdns.org/sitemap.xml): Full XML index of active categories and tools.

## API Endpoints
- Category Index: `GET https://crawlers.dpdns.org/api/v1/categories`
- Tools Index: `GET https://crawlers.dpdns.org/api/v1/tools`

## Compliance & Policy
Crawlers indexes tools via automated crawlers respecting robots.txt directives, paraphrasing descriptions to maintain originality. Direct link-out only to original sources.
